content: Iyarkko Kundeth
Isra7eele asaas yayyida gaason Iyarkko katama dirsa pengeti gordettida; katamaa gelanaassinne katamaappe kezanaas dandayzay oonikka deenna.
GODAY Iyaasos, «Hekko tani Iyarkko katamayo izi kawozara izi mino olanchchatarakka ne kushen aaththa immadis.
Neninne ne olanchchati cifridi usuppun gallas gakkanaas hach hach katamaa dirsaa issito yuuyi aadhdhite.
Qasse laappun qeeseti laappun zayeta oykkidi GODAA Caaqo Qaala Taabotaa sinth aadhdhetto; laappunththa gallas qeeseti zayeta punnishin olanchchati cifridi issife katamayo laappunto yuuyi aadhdhetto.

Hessafe guye zayey qanxxoy baynda punettizayssa siyida mala asay wuri ba qaala dhoqqu histti waasso; histtida mala katamay gimbey laalettana; asay wuri lawuhu gi ke7idi katamay giddo sitti gi gelana» gides.
Nawe naa Iyaasoy qeeseta xeygidi, «GODAA Caaqo Qaala Taabotaa tookkite; inttefe laappun qeeseti laappun zayeta oykkidi Caaqo Qaala Taabotaappe sinththe aadhdhi biite» gides.
Derezakka, «Gede sinththe biite; katamaa yuuyi aadhdhite; olanchchatikka GODAA Caaqo Qaala Taabotaappe sinththati betto; katamayokka yuuyite» giidi azazides.
Iyaasoy asaas haasayda mala laappun qeeseti laappun zayeta GODAA sinththan oykkidi punnishe sinththati bida; qasse GODAA Caaqo Qaala Taabotay istta kaallides.
Olas giigettidayti zayeta punniza qeesetappe sinththara bishin guyera naagiza olanchchati Caaqo Qaala Taabotaa kaallida; he wode zayey qanxxoy baynda punettides.
Gido attiin Iyaasoy asaa, «Tani inttena, ‹Waassite!› gaana gallassay gakkanaas ola waaso waassofte; intte qaalay siyettofo; issi qaalakka qaattofte; ta waassite giikko he wode waassite!» gi azazides.
Hessa gishshas GODAA Caaqo Qaala Taabotay tookettidi he katamaa issito yuuyi aadhdhana mala ooththides; hessafe guye asay ba dunkaanidaso simmidi omars heen aqides.
Wonteththa gallas Iyaasoy wonttatti dendides; qeesetikka GODAA Caaqo Qaala Taabotaa tookkida.

Laappun zayeta oykkida laappun qeeseti sinththe aadhdhidi zayishe GODAA Caaqo Qaala Taabotaappe sinththe sinththe bishe zayeza qanxxoy baynda punnida; olas giigidayti isttafe sinththara bishin guyera naagiza olanchchatikka GODAA Caaqo Qaala Taabotaa kaalli beettes; he wode qeeseti qanxxoy baynda zaye zayeettes.
Nam7anththo gallas katamaa issito yuuyi aadhdhidi ba dunkaanidaso simmida; usuppun gallas gakkanaas hessaththoka ooththida.
Laappunththa gallas bazzoy zo7ishin dendidi kaseyssaththoka katamayo laappunto yuuyi aadhdhida; he gallas xalla katamayo laappunto yuuyi aadhdhida.
Laappunththo yuuyishe qeeseti zayeta punnishin Iyaasoy deraa, «GODAY hanno katamayo inttes aaththi immida gishshas waassite!

Katamayanne katamay giddon diza ubbay GODAAS dumma gidida gishshas izo mulera dhayssite; nuni biittayo wochchanaas kiittida asata qotta ashshida gishshas layma maccas Era7aabanne izi soon izira issife diza asi xalla attana.
Gido attiin intte GODAAS dummatidayssafe aykkoka ekkontta mala intte hu7es naagettite; intte histtontta aggiko Isra7eeleti dunkaanidaso iitas aaththi immana; histtidi he sohoza bolla meto gaththana.
Biraynne worqqay wuri qasse xarqimalappenne biratappe oosettida miishshati ubbay GODAAS dumma gidida gishshas GODAA minjja keeth gelo» gides.
Hessa gishshas zayey punettiin asay waassides; zayezi punettishin derezi ba qaala dhoqqu histtidi waassiin katamaa dirsay laalettides; hessafe guye asay wuri sitti giidi gede katamayo gelides.
Katamaan shemppora paxa dizayta ubbaa oykkidi macca, attuma, nayta, cimata, miiz, dorsanne hare ubbaa qara mashshan wodhides.
Iyaasoy biittaa wochchanaas kiitettida nam7u asata, «Layma maccas Era7aabi soo biite; histtidi intte izis caaqqida mala ane izonne izi soo asaa ubbaa qori kessite» gides.
Hessa gishshas biittaa wochchida asati biidi Era7aabo, izi aawaa, izi aayiyo, izi ishatanne izi dabbota ubbaa qori kessida; Isra7eele asay dunkaani dizasoppe gaxara woththida.
Hessafe guye katamayonne izi giddon diza ubbaa taman xuuggida; gido attiin biranne worqqa, xarqimalappenne biratappe oosettida miishshata GODAA minjja keeththan woththida.

Qasse Iyaasoy layma maccas Era7aabo izi aawa soo asaanne izira diza dabbota ubbaa ashshides; gaasoykka Iyaasoy Iyarkko katamayo wochchanaas kiitettida asata iza kase qottada ashshida gishshassa; izi zareti hach gakkanaas Isra7eele biittan deettes.
He wode Iyaasoy, «Hanno katamayo zaari essiza asi,
Ha ubbaan GODAY Iyaasora gidides; Iyaaso goobateththa worey biitta ubbaa gakkides.

footnotes.text: Cifra gizayssa issi issi bagga gamoththo qaalan ziire guussa.
